title: Emotion Classification in Kazakh Social Media: code, annotation guidelines and privacy-preserving evaluation package
description:
Companion release for Emotion Classification in Kazakh Social Media: What Limits Performance in a Low-Resource Setting? (ICTACS-2026).

Contains the hierarchical LaBSE classifier, the nine reference systems, the design-choice ablation and learning-curve experiments, the inter-annotator agreement script, the collection script, and a privacy-preserving evaluation package. The package gives, for each of the 2,467 authentic Kazakh and Kazakh-Russian posts, a SHA-256 hash of the normalised text together with its label, base-emotion parent, source family, length and explicit-shame-marker flag, which is enough to verify the counts and recompute the reported per-class and macro figures without the post text. The annotation guidelines are included in the Russian working version actually used and in an English rendering.

The post text itself is not included and is available from the authors under a data-use agreement.
